verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's official integrations page says to build search interfaces by pairing Meilisearch with React InstantSearch, so there is a vendor-documented UI component path. The evidence does not show which components are offered, and the library is paired with rather than shown as Meilisearch's own. Faceting docs describe API data that powers UI navigation, not UI components. Missing for 10: evidence of specific components (search box, results, facets, pagination), first-party ownership of the component library, framework coverage beyond React, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, official UI component libraries let me assemble a full search interface — box, results, facets, pagination — without building it from scratch

citations.quote: Build performant, responsive search interfaces by pairing Meilisearch with React InstantSearch.
